design_gotchas.title: Critical SOT-23-5 Suffix Trap: TLV9001IDBVR vs TLV9001UIDBVR Pinout Swap
design_gotchas.detail: Inside the exact same 5-pin SOT-23 (DBV) package, TLV9001IDBVR (Figure 6-1) uses 1=OUT, 2=V-, 3=IN+, 4=IN-, 5=V+ (matching TLV9061IDBVR and OPA333AIDBVR), whereas TLV9001UIDBVR (Figure 6-2, LMV321/MCP6001 style) swaps pins 1, 3, and 4 to 1=IN+, 2=V-, 3=IN-, 4=OUT, 5=V+. Ordering the wrong suffix shorts OUT to IN+.

design_gotchas.title: High 1200 Ω Open-Loop Output Impedance at 1 MHz
design_gotchas.detail: The resistive open-loop output impedance (1200 Ω at 1 MHz) enables easy stability into capacitive loads up to 500 pF, but reduces closed-loop drive stiffness at high frequencies into low-ohm loads.

design_gotchas.title: RRIO Complementary Input Crossover Reduces Upper-Rail CMRR
design_gotchas.detail: CMRR is 95 dB typ below (V+) - 1.4 V, but drops to 77 dB typ (63 dB min) when signals cross the complementary input transition near (V+) - 1.4 V. Keep precision low-side sensing below V+ - 1.4 V.

design_gotchas.title: 5.5 V Operating Supply Limit and ±10 mA ESD Clamp Diode Fault Limit
design_gotchas.detail: Rated for 1.8 V to 5.5 V operation (7 V abs max). Input pins are diode-clamped to V+ and V-; any input excursion >0.5 V beyond supply rails must be current-limited to ≤10 mA.

typical_use_cases: Battery-powered IoT, wearable, and smoke-detector sensor signal conditioning
1.8 V–5.5 V low-side current sensing and active filter stages
Cost-sensitive RRIO single-channel ADC buffers with 500 pF capacitive-load stability
Ultra-low-bias (5 pA) high-impedance voltage follower and instrumentation buffers
engineering_summary: The Texas Instruments TLV9001IDBVR is a low-power (60 µA typ), 1 MHz, 2 V/µs rail-to-rail input and output (RRIO) single CMOS operational amplifier in a 5-pin SOT-23 (DBV) package operating from 1.8 V to 5.5 V (-40°C to 125°C). It pairs ±0.4 mV typical offset (±1.6 mV max), 5 pA input bias current, integrated RFI/EMI filtering, and 500 pF capacitive-load stability. It shares TI's standard DBV SOT-23-5 pinout (1=OUT, 2=V-, 3=IN+, 4=IN-, 5=V+) with TLV9061IDBVR and OPA333AIDBVR, but differs critically from the alternate TLV9001UIDBVR (U-variant) SOT-23-5 pinout.
